description:
## Goal
Add the Elixir-shaped named definition entry points without adding lexer tokens or a definition-specific source parser. `def` and `defp` must arrive as ordinary identifier calls, expand through runtime macros that capture __CALLER__, and terminate at the existing Fz.Compiler.define / FunctionForm / FunctionSource machinery.

## Data-model changes
- Extend the quoted-surface definition-head set, reserved name/arity discovery, clause grouping, mixed-kind validation, and canonical typed extraction to def/defp.
- Define runtime `def/1` and `defp/1` macros beside defmacro, forwarding the untouched quoted clause to Fz.Compiler.define with __CALLER__.
- Derive `is_private` from defp and `is_macro` from defmacro; keep downstream publication, namespace, module interface, reachability, lazy body expansion, and backend export rules unchanged.
- Treat protocol callbacks as ordinary def calls and require contextual identifier `def` after an extern ABI. defp remains invalid in both contexts.
- Normalize an Elixir-style bare head (`def foo do`) as arity zero at definition extraction, without teaching the lexer or item parser what def means.
- Require typed operator operands to use the unambiguous Elixir AST shape, e.g. `def (left :: integer) + (right :: integer), do: ...`; do not preserve the current definition-only type-token collector as a hidden grammar.

## Scope and environment proof
Generic item parsing currently stamps source lexical metadata without knowing a function name. That is desirable only if the define tier remains authoritative. Tests must prove __ENV__.function, __CALLER__, quote/unquote, local macro resolution, generated definitions, lambda occurrence identity, nested modules, and semantic retraction still derive from ScopeSnapshot and the FunctionSource identity. Do not add a def parser solely to recover parser-stamped function scope.

## TDD and signal
Add lexer tests that both words are Tok::Ident and no Def/Defp variants exist. Add exact quoted-AST frontdoor tests for block and keyword bodies, guards, bare zero-arity heads, untyped and typed operator heads, protocol callbacks, and extern declarations. Add production compiler tests for multiple clauses, attributes, forward references, public/private interface visibility, mixed def/defp rejection, item macros that generate definitions, definition replacement/retraction, and environment projection. Use existing macro-expansion and function-source telemetry to prove one macro bounce and one grouped FunctionSource publication.

## Temporary construction state
Keep old named fn/fnp entry points only long enough for the existing corpus to remain green. This is explicitly owned and deleted by fz-6lf.4; it is not an alias implementation and must not canonicalize def back to fn.

## Documentation
Update `.agent/docs/macro-expansion.md`, `.agent/docs/quoted-source.md`, `.agent/docs/modules.md`, `.agent/docs/protocols.md`, and `.agent/docs/externs.md` where the new authority changes facts. Record that function syntax names end at quoted-surface extraction; downstream code consumes FunctionForm flags.

## Acceptance
The quicksort fixture compiles unchanged except for fn->def and fnp->defp, including its guarded clauses. No Def or Defp lexer/token-payload variant exists. The generic AST reaches Fz.Compiler.define with correct grouping, privacy, lexical environment, and lazy-body behavior on real compiler paths.
title: Route identifier def/defp through the existing definition macro pipeline
